game_title: Else Escape – Net Menders' Pier Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Coastal Port – Net Menders' Pier, a pier of net menders: the deckhand must handle pirate raiders while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Else Escape: Handle both branches of if/else: attack one kind of pirate raiders, dodge the other.
theme: Coastal Port – Net Menders' Pier: a pier of net menders
core_gameplay_loop: In Net Menders' Pier, repeat each round: Handle both branches of if/else: attack one kind of pirate raiders, dodge the other. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the hero_hp value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the harbor gate using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The harbor gate reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the harbor gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 3 (intro tier): Else Escape
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Else Escape' (Week 3 slot 2), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Net Menders' Pier'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how hero_hp changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against pirate raiders in Net Menders' Pier.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The harbor gate reached with actions_used <= 19.
